# serverconfig.txt — tModLoader dedicated server configuration
#
# This is the TEMPLATE / reference file.
# The real serverconfig.txt is generated in server/ by running:
#   python scripts/setup.py
# or:
#   python scripts/generate_serverconfig.py
#
# After editing config/server-config.json, re-run the above command
# to regenerate server/serverconfig.txt.
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── World settings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Full path to the .wld file to load (generated by setup.py)
world=

# Name for auto-created worlds
worldname=MyWorld

# Folder where worlds are stored (generated by setup.py — points to worlds/)
worldpath=

# 1 = create a new world if the .wld file doesn't exist; 0 = require existing file
autocreate=1

# World size: 1 (small) | 2 (medium) | 3 (large)
worldsize=2

# Difficulty: 0 (classic) | 1 (expert) | 2 (master) | 3 (journey)
difficulty=1

# Random seed (leave blank for a random seed)
seed=

# ── Server settings ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Name shown in the server list
servername=My tModLoader Server

# Port the server listens on (default 7777 for Terraria)
port=7777

# Maximum number of players at once
maxplayers=8

# Server password (leave blank for no password)
password=

# Message shown when players join
motd=Welcome! Type /help for commands.

# ── Security ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 1 = kick players using known cheats; 0 = allow everything
secure=1

# Server language
# Options: en-US  de-DE  it-IT  fr-FR  es-ES  ru-RU  zh-Hans  pt-BR  pl-PL
language=en-US

# ── tModLoader-specific ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 1 = automatically load mods from the Mods folder
autoloadmods=1

# NPC sync rate (10–60; lower reduces network traffic on slow connections)
npcstream=60

# Process priority: 0=realtime 1=high 2=above-normal 3=normal 4=below-normal 5=idle
priority=1
